_fixture: what .claude/skills/apply-job/scan-page.js produces for pages/greenhouse-step1.html — REGENERATED by running the real scanner over the served page
_bridge: tests/security/scan-fidelity.test.mjs runs the REAL scanner over that HTML and deep-compares this file to its output; tests/security/board-fidelity.test.mjs additionally checks the served page carries the traits it claims. Edit one and the other goes red.
_keys: COMBOS ARE STAMPED FIRST. scan-page.js's combo loop runs before the input loop, so the react-select is f1 and the text inputs start at f2 — even though the sorted output puts the combo between the file inputs and the textarea. An earlier hand-written version of this file numbered fields in reading order and gave the combo f10, which is a shape the scanner cannot produce.
_section: ONLY the two file inputs carry `section`, and that is the point of case E8. Both are labelled `Attach`; the heading that tells resume from cover letter sits outside the element labelOf() reads, and until 2026-07-31 nothing carried it, so the two fields were the same string and only document order separated them. The per-section <h3>s were added to the served page on 2026-07-31 so that assertion has something real to read — before them this page's ONLY heading was the page <h1>, whose parent is <body>, which scan-page.js deliberately never treats as a section. Nothing else on the page carries the key BECAUSE nothing else sits under a heading whose own parent contains it: a key with the same value on every field distinguishes nothing, which is the property `section` exists to supply.
_section_not_consumed: OPEN FINDING as of 2026-07-31. The scan now CARRIES the heading and no consumer reads it — `section` appears nowhere in scripts/apply/. buildPlan still tells the two `Attach` inputs apart by adapter.fileOrder plus document order, exactly as before. So E8 is half closed: the contradiction is now VISIBLE in the scan, and nothing yet acts on it.
_sel: The combo and both radios have NO `sel`: stableSel() needs a unique id or a unique name/data-testid/data-qa/aria-label. The combo has none of those (its `data-aj-testid` is not `data-testid`) and the two radios SHARE a name, so no attribute selector is unique to either.
